meta.title: TourLink | Your link to Central Asia
meta.description: Private trips, group programs, and routes across Uzbekistan and Central Asia from the TourLink team.

hero.title: Your link to
hero.description: Private trips, group programs, and agency routes built around real places, people, and the rhythm of the road.
hero.note: TourLink designs and coordinates its own programs across Central Asia — from a first trip in Uzbekistan to a wide Silk Road route.

countries.title: Five countries. One Silk Road line.
countries.description: Our home is Uzbekistan. The route can reach mountains, steppe, and desert roads when the trip needs a wider regional arc.

uzbekistan.name: Uzbekistan
uzbekistan.description: Silk Road cities, crafts, architecture, and tightly logical routes.

tajikistan.name: Tajikistan
tajikistan.description: Where the Pamir touches the sky

experiences.title: How Central Asia feels
experiences.description: Six route sensations through which a traveler senses the region before dates, transfers, and city names.

historical_walks.title: Historical walks
historical_walks.description: In a historic city, tiles, carved doors, and courtyard shade stop being separate details when a guide connects them to the street around you.

craft_meetings.title: Craft encounters
craft_meetings.description: In a workshop clay stays on the table and silk thread catches the light. A handmade line never repeats itself twice.

bazaar_courtyard.title: Bazaar and courtyard
bazaar_courtyard.description: Bukhara comes closer in small pauses: tea by the water, shade in a courtyard, market voices after the monuments.

sacred_heritage.title: Sacred heritage in context
sacred_heritage.description: Under a dome or by a shrine courtyard, steps grow quieter. A guide opens the human story of the place.

nature_routes.title: Routes in nature
nature_routes.description: On a mountain road or by a desert lake the route grows quieter. The driver knows where the light shifts and the wind rises.

desert_oasis.title: Desert and oasis nights
desert_oasis.description: At the edge of a desert camp after sunset the sand releases its heat and the sky opens wider than the road behind you.

trip_formats.title: Every trip has its own rhythm
trip_formats.description: First we choose the shape of the trip: private pace, group energy, family days, or a business program.

private.title: Private tours
private.description: Dates, pace, and interests shape the trip. The route can stay in Silk Road cities or reach mountains and quieter stops.

group.title: Group programs
group.description: A shared departure runs on clear timing. You travel with a group, but the day still leaves room for context, food, and the city.

family.title: Family pace
family.description: Shorter days, a softer start, and fewer unnecessary stops help the route work across ages.

mice.title: MICE and incentive
mice.description: Meetings, transfers, meals, and translation move in one rhythm while guests still feel the place.

how_we_work.title: A route holds on people, not a list of cities
how_we_work.description: TourLink grew from people, routes, and regional experience within Orient Star Group. As a tour operator we start with a real day on the route: season, distance, guide, transport, border, and group energy.
how_we_work.quote: A trip needs rhythm before it becomes a list of transfers.

featured_routes.title: Tours across Central Asia
featured_routes.description: First route directions. Programs are built around dates, countries, group size, and pace.

essentials.title: Uzbekistan Essentials
essentials.description: A short first route through Tashkent, Samarkand, and Bukhara tailored to your dates and pace.

silk_road.title: Silk Road Cities
silk_road.description: Guide, crafts, and quieter evenings between the main stops on the route.

regional.title: Central Asia Route
regional.description: A wider regional line — borders, flights, and roads are checked before the program is promised.

why.title: What changes when one team leads the route

programs.title: Own programs
programs.description: TourLink builds and runs its own tour programs rather than reselling someone else's bundle.

rhythm.title: Route rhythm
rhythm.description: Days are shaped by distance, season, access, and the time a place needs to open up.

connection.title: One regional link
connection.description: Travelers and agencies work with one team for routes, guides, transport, and regional changes.

trade_fairs.title: Where TourLink meets the travel market
trade_fairs.description: Fairs where the TourLink team meets operators, travel companies, and destination partners.

journal.title: Notes from the route
journal.description: Practical notes, route context, and observations from the TourLink team.

craft_workshop.title: A workshop with time for it

road_day.title: A road day that cannot be rushed

cta.title: Tell us
cta.description: Send dates, countries, group size, and preferred pace. TourLink will propose a route the team can confidently run in the region.
